name: llm-compare
description: LLM Compare — race the same agentic task across multiple LLMs and compare correctness, speed, tokens and cost.

scripts.test: node test/mock-run.js && node test/verify-enhancements.js && node test/verify-local-e2e.js && node test/verify-followup.js && node test/verify-claude-scaled.js && node test/verify-image-policy.js && node test/verify-user-preferences.js && node test/verify-pdf-export.js && node test/verify-saved-prompts-and-games.js && node test/verify-byok-strict.js && node test/verify-run-budgets.js && node test/verify-spend-budgets.js && node test/verify-budget-enforcement.js && node test/verify-arena-polish-and-regressions.js && node test/verify-3d-arena.js && node test/verify-auth-hardening.js && node test/verify-release-renders.js
scripts.test:smoke: node test/smoke-http.js && node test/smoke-followup.js && node test/smoke-secrets.js && node test/smoke-secondary.js
scripts.cloud:status: CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME=argolis gcloud run services describe llm-compare --project=llm-compare-ubhits --region=us-central1 --format='table(status.traffic.revisionName,status.traffic.percent,status.traffic.tag,status.traffic.url)'
scripts.cloud:promote-beta: CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME=argolis gcloud run services update-traffic llm-compare --project=llm-compare-ubhits --region=us-central1 --to-tags=beta=100
